measurement: Ask accuracy hill-climb on DBpedia 2022.12.01: predicate-use grounding, popularity-ordered linking, two generic prompt rules and the Ask repair options, against the main-branch baseline, with Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol
host: A development laptop with 16 cores and 30 GB of memory that was running other work. Binaries were built on atlas and copied back.

scoring.headline: rdf-term-set-projected-columns-v2, the strict score of record
scoring.secondary: rdf-term-set-projected-guarded-lenient-v3 with gold-errata-v1, defined by testsuite/ask/eval_support/guarded.py at commit 65d648d3, with which every run below was rescored
scoring.unflagged: guarded passes minus those flagged predicate_column, predicate_column_unknown or projection_drops_rows

split.fresh: fresh-150, from the QALD-9-plus training split, 150 of 306 scorable questions chosen by SHA256 of "ask-hillclimb-fresh-v1:ID" after 6 duplicates of test or db25 questions were dropped

anthropic.walletHistory: The Anthropic wallet of this campaign was USD 50. On 2026-11-01 the person who pays approved raising it to USD 95 so that Haiku, Sonnet and Opus could each run the baseline and the final build on QALD, db25 and unseen. The first ledger closed at USD 30.7865 of upper liability and a second ledger holds a cap of USD 64.2135; the two caps sum to the wallet.

openai.walletHistory: The OpenAI wallet began at USD 40 on 2026-11-01 and the person who pays raised it to USD 50 the same day, after the Luna baselines. A ledger cap is fixed in its header, so the first ledger closed and a second ledger holds the rest; the two caps sum to the wallet.

notes: Haiku QALD runs h-v3-qald-r1 and h-v3-qald-r2 used commit 30b0a968, which builds the same prompts on this database as 570d7062, as the dry runs show.
h-base-fresh-r1 stopped after 42 of 150 questions on five provider errors in a row; h-base-fresh-r1b is the full rerun.
The Sonnet and Opus QALD and db25 baselines are the 7b3b6df5 runs of the earlier paid record, rescored here.

Lever trials t-*-r1..r3 ran each Ask repair option three times on Haiku over qald-validation-v2 (51 questions): the 35 validation questions and 16 training questions no tuning step inspected case by case, chosen by SHA256 of "ask-hillclimb-val-v2:ID" from the uninspected training IDs.
f6-* runs are the finals with the final defaults (exploration on, shape check, voting and type hints off) at commit dfc799dc; b-* runs are baselines at 2d43aa5a on the unseen set.
unseen-150 is a second set of 150 QALD-9-plus training questions disjoint from every set above, which no tuning step read.
ob-* runs are OpenAI baselines at 2d43aa5a with the two OpenAI harness commits 8c053944 and ca76197d (binary oaibase-e2fe15cc), run one child per question; of-* runs are OpenAI finals at dfc799dc.

ob-luna-qald-r1 was OOM-killed in a 12 GiB scope shared with its single child and left no summary; its $0.11 stays in the first OpenAI ledger, and ob-luna-qald-r1b is the rerun with 16 GiB child scopes.

f6-o-unseen-r1 was refused by the admission check before any case ran: it projects the 90th-percentile Opus case cost times 150 questions times 1.25, which passed what the cap left. f6-o-unseen-r2 is the same build, settings and questions in three blocks of 50 (sets unseen-150-a, -b and -c), merged into one report of unseen-150 by tools/merge_parts.py.
Opus base on unseen (b-o-unseen-r1) was not run, deferred for budget at the USD 95 cap; it is pending approval of a raise.

OpenAI runs ob3-* (binary oaibase3-dd0d5430) and of3-* (binary final8-3a138901) carry the follow-up repair form of 19a02832 and fd7dbf48, so a repair repeats the first draft message and OpenAI serves its prefix from the cache. Earlier ob-* and of-luna-qald-r1 runs predate it and are kept as extra data.

The default model is chosen by tools/decide.py: on unseen-150, the cheapest model per correct answer whose paired bootstrap 95% interval of the difference from the best model contains zero (10,000 resamples, seed 7). QALD and db25 are reported as checks.
Runs after the lever trials are scored by guarded.py at the lane tip, whose changes since 65d648d3 change no guarded result on any set question.
db25-65, a comma-separated literal gold, stays wrong under both scores pending an owner decision.

decision.rule:
Rule: on the unseen set, the cheapest model per correct answer whose strict score is
within the noise of the best model's, where within the noise means the paired bootstrap
95% interval of (best - candidate) over questions contains 0. QALD and db25 are checks.
The same rule is applied within each provider for its preset.
